insights.one_liner: Rotterdam electronics retailer with about 3,800 staff, known for doing its own delivery and service; a recognised visa sponsor, expanding in Belgium.

culture.text: A large company of about 3,833 people, running its own webshop, stores, customer service, warehouses and delivery under the motto 'anything for a smile'.
Many staff come from Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences, Avans, Tilburg, Erasmus and Fontys, mostly in economics, business and marketing.
Main jobs are in operations, sales, IT, engineering and customer support.

open.text: Coolblue B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Works in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany, but its staff come mostly from Dutch universities.

growth.text: Plans 10 more stores in Belgium, including a new one in Sint-Niklaas.
Is moving to the Blue Gate site in Antwerp alongside Albert Heijn and AB InBev.

worth_knowing.text: Owned by Mondhoekie B.V., a Dutch holding company, and privately held rather than listed.
